_readme: Site-wide state. `status` is the one switch that decides whether this site
pre-launch  the site is a working draft. Unverified figures render with
their flags on, banners say what is provisional, and every
build prints the outstanding list so it cannot be forgotten.
live        the site claims to be real. tools/build.py refuses to build
at all while anything unverified would reach a visitor.
The gate exists because the failure mode is silence: a placeholder that
nobody removes looks exactly like a fact to a distributor reading it. The
build will not let that ship. To launch, clear the list the gate prints,
`canonical_origin` is written into every page's canonical link. It must be
the domain actually served. Pointing it at a domain that does not answer
keeps the site out of the index.
`hidden_pages` are templates that exist but are not built, not linked and
not in the sitemap. A page is hidden when it promises something that does
not exist yet: the dealer resources page lists a literature library in which
every file is still null, which reads as a library a buyer cannot reach.
Remove the entry to publish the page again.
